headline: PM Ali al-Zaidi ordered indefinite closure of Sheeb border crossing with Iran
dek: PM Ali al-Zaidi ordered the indefinite closure of the Sheeb (al-Sheib, Maysan governorate) crossing with Iran from 6 a.m. Wednesday for both commercial and passenger traffic until further notice, with other Iraq-Iran crossings to be closed gradually under the PM's instructions.
sources: Iraqi government official (to Al Jazeera); official sources to APA, 964media, Shafaq News (Maysan Provincial Council)
fault_line: Sovereign decision or American pressure — and who pays for it? Commenters already flag tomato/egg prices; pocketbook angle is live.

sections.what_happened: PM Ali al-Zaidi ordered the indefinite closure of the Sheeb (al-Sheib, Maysan governorate) crossing with Iran from 6 a.m. Wednesday for both commercial and passenger traffic until further notice, with other Iraq-Iran crossings to be closed gradually under the PM's instructions. No reason disclosed; Shafaq's source cites 'technical reasons'. 964media notes key crossings were also temporarily shut in September after a drone attack on Saudi Arabia launched from Iraqi soil.
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera liveblog, APA, 964media, Shafaq News, TimesNow, Hatha Alyoum agree on closure + 6 a.m. start + gradual follow-on. Social demand confirms: Iran International IG 7.3K likes/230 comments, Al Jazeera Arabic FB 3.6K/560, Kurdish AVA IG 2.4K likes/9.6K comments, Baghdad Today 1.7K/140.
sections.what_disputed: No reason given by any outlet; several commenters claim the crossing remains open — unconfirmed social claims. HRNW ties an earlier closure wave to a Saudi-pipeline drone attack launched from Iraqi soil (AFP) — plausible context but not the stated reason.
sections.why_matters: Iraq sealing its own frontier with Iran while the war runs next door: the map of crossings (Sheeb, Shalamcheh, Mandali) + the September drone precedent + the unanswered why — from Baghdad's impossible position, not Washington's.
sections.context: Background: Iraq — MISSED ITEM, now corroborated: PM Ali al-Zaidi ordered indefinite closure of Sheeb border crossing with Iran (from Wed Oct 21 06:00) and gradual closure of other Iran crossings; no reason given (Shafaq cites 'technical reasons')
